abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Brostamide and Alvenor reach about the same systolic drop.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Brostamide and Alvenor reach about the same systolic drop.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Oakfield Family Cohort.

Table 1. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 11.7 | 5.8 | 500 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Systolic drop | 11.6 | 5.8 | 500 |

These values are listed for every arm and every subset.
